result: For every prime p congruent to 1 modulo 4 and every s in {3,7,11}, H_((sp-1)/2)(z;zeta_sp) is squarefree in characteristic zero at every primitive zeta_sp. Consequently the all-A local overlap formula is unconditional at lower orders d=sp.
new_mechanism: Complete inverse-parameter Hermite pairing at A=(p-1)/2: simultaneous failure occurs exactly when p=1 mod4 and tau=tau_prime=2; augmented same-component product Gamma Gamma^iota (2g-v) excludes it.
additional_lemma: For all s=3 mod4, g_s and 2g_s-v_s are nonzero in characteristic zero by an explicit sine-sector argument; this does not establish residual squarefreeness.
exact_adverse_control: s=7,p=13 has one inverse-stable residual-good factor with tau=2; two other factors pass. Ordinary paired residual guards alone do not validate arbitrary choice of component in the new parity.
remaining: Uniform unramified support of augmented content
scope_boundaries: s=3,7,11 and p=1mod4 ensures p does not divide s
d=3mod4 remains resonant, so no m-pole legal-bank conclusion
